licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 239–244, bars 1–121 of No. 23
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (in two page ranges, pp. 239–241 and 242–244), a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean, apart from one slur in bars 118–119 that runs from the right hand's lower voice to its upper voice and cannot be written in the file, so it is left out). The German singing translation is left out. Bar 1 is the one-eighth upbeat, set as 1/8. The “NB” cut sign at the final barline (bar 121; usually the performance jumps from here to the recitative on p. 262) is not written in the score. Playback tempo: an eighth note = 80 (♩ = 40), from Jacobs (4:36); Mozart gives the words Andante grazioso only.
